expr: y_d1 = wblpdf(1); y_dh = wblpdf(0.5); y_d0 = wblpdf(0); y_dn = wblpdf(-0.5); y_w = wblpdf(1, 2, 3); y_2 = wblpdf(2, 1, 1); y_z = wblpdf(0, 1, 1); y_zk_lt1 = wblpdf(0, 1, 0.5); y_zk_gt1 = wblpdf(0, 1, 2); y_v = wblpdf(xs, 1, 2); y_a0 = wblpdf(1, 0, 1); y_aneg = wblpdf(1, -1, 1); y_b0 = wblpdf(1, 1, 0); y_bneg = wblpdf(1, 1, -1); y_nan_x = wblpdf(NaN, 1, 1); y_nan_a = wblpdf(1, NaN, 1);
comment: Sig: y = wblpdf(x[, a, b]). Weibull PDF with scale a, shape b. Defaults a=1, b=1 (= exponential). Edges: x<0 -> 0; x=0 -> b/a if b=1, Inf if b<1, 0 if b>1; a<=0 or b<=0 -> NaN; NaN -> NaN.
